usage: agentware prefer review [-h] [--format {text,json}] [--rejected]
                               [--approved] [--all]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --rejected            also show tier-3 rejected candidates (kernel-path /
                        gate-loosening)
  --approved            also show already-approved candidates (awaiting their
                        workorder run)
  --all                 show candidates in EVERY state (incl. queued /
                        journaled)
